summary:
Z.E.U.S. is an intelligent health monitoring system for astronauts that combines a minimally invasive biometric patch, capable of collecting data without constant connectivity, with a software platform designed to monitor their health throughout space missions.

The project is designed to track six key health indicators: heart rate, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, body temperature, blood pressure, and sleep patterns.

Its main differentiator is the ability to continuously collect biometric data even during connectivity interruptions, automatically synchronizing the information once communication is restored.

The software platform enables real-time visualization of physiological data, analysis of health trends, and intelligent alerts to support early detection of potential medical risks.

Our goal is to enhance astronaut safety and autonomy through a compact, comfortable, and integrated solution specifically designed to address the challenges of space exploration.

Z.E.U.S. — Your Health. Beyond Earth.
details:
Z.E.U.S. (Zero-Gravity Emergency & Utility System) is a comprehensive health monitoring solution designed for astronauts during space missions.

The project combines a minimally invasive biometric patch with an intelligent medical monitoring platform, enabling the tracking of six key health indicators: heart rate, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation, body temperature, blood pressure, and sleep patterns.

The patch is designed to collect biometric data even without continuous connectivity, while the software enables real-time visualization of physiological data, trend analysis, and intelligent health alerts.

Our goal is to enhance astronaut safety, autonomy, and medical risk prevention during space missions through a compact, comfortable, and technologically accessible solution.

Z.E.U.S. — Your Health. Beyond Earth.
